name: Organisation Name
definition: Name by which an organisation is known and which is usually used to identify that organisation.

LegalName.name: Legal Name
LegalName.definition: Official name under which an organisation is registered.

TradingName.name: Trading Name
TradingName.definition: Name used by a business for commercial purposes, although its registered legal name, used for contracts and other formal situations, may be another.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Specifies the short name of the organisation.

Organisation.name: Organisation
Organisation.definition: Organisation identification which contains a name.
